newsitem.title: USA: Bonneville withdraws next-day peak power offers.
newsitem.headline: Bonneville withdraws next-day peak power offers.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) dropped offers of surplus power during peak demand hours for Wednesday delivery, but continued to offer off-peak supplies, the agency said Tuesday.
On Monday, the agency had offered 100 megawatts (MW) of next-day power at $17.50 for Northwest and $18.50 for California-Oregon border (COB) sales.

For Wednesday pre-schedulings, BPA continued to offer non-firm power for hours ending at 0600 and 2300 PDT at $9.50 per megawatt hour (MWh) for both Northwest and COB deliveries, while delivered prices for hours ending 0100-0500 and 2400 were flat at $9.00.
Firm power during off-peak hours on Wednesday was also unchanged at $9.00 per MWh for all deliveries.
